scripts.build:sites: npm run build && npm run build:worker
scripts.check:route: npm run build:worker && esbuild scripts/local-route-check.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=/tmp/local-route-check.mjs --log-level=warning && node /tmp/local-route-check.mjs
scripts.check:image:route: npm run build:worker && esbuild scripts/live-image-route-check.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=/tmp/live-image-route-check.mjs --log-level=warning && node /tmp/live-image-route-check.mjs
scripts.dev:app: npm run build:sites && esbuild scripts/dev-app-server.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=/tmp/dev-app-server.mjs --log-level=warning && node /tmp/dev-app-server.mjs
